what: a bugbear: a very tall, heavy, long-armed goblin-kin brute standing upright on two legs, its whole body shaggy with coarse fur, with a wide flat goblin face, a broad mouth with two short lower tusks, long pointed ears and small yellow eyes. It has the build of a tall powerful man with a small head, a thick neck and long heavy arms.
colours: shaggy dark brown fur all over the body, a bare tan-yellow face, yellow eyes, a plain pale wooden club.
wears: It wears only a ragged grey hide loincloth and one leather strap across its chest; no armour at all and nothing on its head.
holds: It holds exactly one thick, plain wooden club in its right hand, with no spikes and no metal on it. Its left hand is an open empty clawed hand with nothing in it.
pose: It creeps forward on two legs with its knees bent and its back hunched, weight on the front foot, the club drawn far back over its right shoulder ready to smash down, its empty left hand reaching out ahead of it, mouth open in a snarl.
must_show: tall furry goblin-kin on two legs (pointed ears, goblin face)
shaggy brown fur over the whole body
one plain wooden club
no armour, loincloth only

what: a hobgoblin captain: a tall, broad-shouldered, upright goblin-kin army officer with dark green skin, a flat fierce face, short pointed ears and small tusks, with the build of a strong adult man. A short banner pole is strapped to his back and rises behind his left shoulder, carrying a small square war banner above his head.
colours: dark forest-green skin, blackened iron armour, a dull red tabard, a dull red banner with a black fist on it, a tall red horsehair crest on the helmet, a black iron shield with a red stripe.
wears: He wears a full officer's kit: a blackened iron helmet with a tall red horsehair crest running front to back, a mail shirt, iron shoulder plates and iron greaves over a dull red tabard.
holds: He holds exactly one curved sword in his right hand and exactly one large rectangular iron shield on his left arm.
pose: He advances to the left in a drilled stance on two legs, front knee bent, the big shield raised in front of his body and the sword levelled over its top edge, chin down behind the rim.
must_show: hobgoblin (dark green skin, tusks, upright soldier)
crested helmet and full armour
one sword and one large shield
a banner on a pole rising from his back
an officer, better equipped than a plain hobgoblin

what: a bugbear chieftain: a very tall, massive, long-armed goblin-kin warlord standing upright on two legs, with a wide flat goblin face, a roaring mouth with two big lower tusks, long pointed ears, a scar across one eye and small yellow eyes. Thick shaggy fur grows over his whole body: his chest, belly, arms and legs are all furry, with no bare skin except the face. He has the build of a huge powerful man with a small head, a thick neck and long heavy arms.
colours: shaggy black-brown fur all over the body, a bare tan-yellow face, a grey wolf-pelt mantle, dark iron plates, ivory skulls, a dark iron spiked ball.
wears: He wears a grey wolf-pelt mantle over both shoulders. Strapped on top of the pelt on his left shoulder is one big dark iron shoulder plate with three long iron spikes standing up from it. He also wears iron bracers, a hide war-kilt and a wide belt with three small ivory skulls hanging from it.
holds: He holds exactly one morningstar in his right hand: a thick wooden handle as long as his arm with a big round iron ball at its end, the ball studded all over with long iron spikes. His left hand is an empty clenched fist.
pose: He stands on two legs with his feet wide and one foot stamping forward, head thrown back and jaws stretched wide open roaring at the sky, his right arm stretched straight up so the morningstar is held high above his head, his left fist clenched and drawn back at his side.
must_show: tall furry goblin-kin on two legs (pointed ears, goblin face, furry chest and limbs)
spiked morningstar: handle with a spiked iron ball
skulls hanging from the belt
pelt mantle and a spiked iron shoulder plate
roaring, mouth wide open
clearly the leader, more ornate than the plain bugbear

what: a mud crawler: a squat, low, heavy four-legged river reptile, a real animal half snapping turtle and half crocodile, plastered with mud. It has a broad flat body, a short thick neck, a blunt hooked beak like a snapping turtle, four short bowed legs ending in long hooked claws, and a short thick ridged crocodile tail. Its whole back is buried under a thick lumpy crust of dried river mud, dull and matt, split by deep dark cracks like a dried-up riverbed, with rough clods and dried drips of mud hanging down over its sides and smeared on its legs and head. The crust is rough and uneven, not a neat shell: it has no tidy plates and no pattern.
colours: dark brown scaly hide, a dull grey-brown crust of dried cracked mud with dark cracks on the back, mud smears on the legs and head, a dull yellow beak and claws, small amber eyes.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it lunges to the left on four legs, belly low, one front leg lifted and reaching with its hooked claws, beak open and snapping.
must_show: a squat plated reptile on four legs
a rough crust of dried cracked mud on its back (dull grey-brown, not a clean tortoise shell)
hooked snapping beak
long hooked claws

what: a komodo brute: a real Komodo dragon grown to the size of a horse, a huge heavy monitor lizard on four legs. It has a long flat head with a blunt snout, a long thick neck with loose folds of skin, a long barrel body, four thick sprawled legs with big black claws, a very long heavy tail, and a long forked tongue flicking from its mouth.
colours: dusty grey-brown pebbled scales with darker charcoal bands, a pale sandy throat, a long yellow forked tongue, black claws.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it stalks to the left on four sprawled legs with one front foot lifted mid-step, head low and thrust forward, jaws parted showing small saw teeth, the forked yellow tongue out, its long tail curving up behind.
must_show: a real Komodo dragon: a giant monitor lizard on four legs
long forked yellow tongue
long heavy tail and long body
grey-brown scales, no shell

what: a cyclops brute, a one-eyed giant of Greek myth who lives for fighting, a one-eyed monster in a crude one-eyed war helmet. His helmet is a rounded dome of thick dark iron, hammered and dented, with a broad flat iron face-plate riveted to its brow that hangs down over his face to the tip of his nose. In the very middle of the face-plate, in the centre of his forehead directly above his nose, is cut exactly one big round hole, as wide as half his face, and that one hole is filled by his one enormous round eyeball, wide open, with a white eyeball and a big round yellow-brown iris. The rest of the face-plate is one unbroken sheet of solid dented iron with a row of rivets along its edge. Below the face-plate show his broken flat nose, a heavy jutting jaw with rough black stubble and a wide bellowing mouth of crooked teeth. He is a very tall, very heavy, thick-limbed giant man, bigger and uglier than a shepherd cyclops, with a thick neck, a deep barrel chest, a heavy belly and huge knotted arms crossed with long pale scars.
colours: weathered tan-brown skin with long pale scars, one giant eyeball with a white eyeball and a big yellow-brown iris, black stubble, a dark iron dome helmet with a face-plate and rough dark iron armour plates, dark brown leather straps, a shaggy dark brown bearskin kilt, a jagged lump of plain grey quarry stone.
wears: He wears crude armour he has hammered together himself: the dark iron dome helmet whose face-plate has one round eye-hole; one big rough dented dark iron plate strapped over his left shoulder; two thick dark brown leather straps crossing his chest with a big iron ring where they meet; a broad dark iron band on each wrist; and a kilt of shaggy dark brown bearskin held by a wide leather belt.
holds: He holds exactly one jagged lump of plain grey quarry stone as big as his own head, with broken angular faces, gripped in both hands low in front of his belt, well below his face; it is bare broken rock, with no holes, no marks and no pattern on it. Both hands are on this one stone and he holds nothing else.
pose: He stands tall on two legs with his feet apart, one foot stepping forward, leaning back a little, both arms down holding the boulder low at his belt ready to heave it forward, his helmeted head lifted and turned to face the viewer squarely so that the one great eye in the one round hole stares straight out, his mouth bellowing.
must_show: exactly one eye: one enormous eyeball filling the single round hole in the front of an iron helmet, big enough to read in the small sprite
a scarred giant on two legs, heavier than the shepherd cyclops
crude dark iron: pot helmet, shoulder plate, wrist bands, crossed leather straps
a dark brown fur kilt, not a cream sheepskin
one plain boulder gripped in both hands, held low

what: a demon captain: a tall, lean, hard-muscled demon officer standing upright on two legs, with dark red skin, a stern scarred face, two long black horns sweeping back from his brow, glowing yellow eyes, a pair of black bat wings half folded behind his shoulders and a thin barbed tail. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: dark brick-red skin, black horns, black iron plate armour with tarnished brass trim, a tattered black cape, a sword blade glowing orange-hot like metal fresh from the forge.
wears: He wears a veteran officer's kit: a black iron breastplate with tarnished brass trim, black iron shoulder plates, bracers and greaves, a brass captain's gorget at his throat, and a short tattered black cape. His head is bare so the horns show.
holds: He holds exactly one broad straight sword in his right hand, its thick blade glowing orange-hot from hilt to tip. His left hand is an empty clawed hand with nothing in it.
pose: He lunges to the left on two legs in a fencer's long step, front knee bent, the glowing sword thrust straight out ahead of him, his empty left hand held back for balance, wings half spread behind.
must_show: demon: red skin, horns, bat wings
black iron officer's armour with brass trim
one sword with an orange-hot glowing blade
empty left hand
a disciplined veteran soldier, not a wild beast

what: the captain of the Wild Hunt: a tall, gaunt, ghostly huntsman-king of northern legend standing on two legs, like Herne the Hunter. Two great branching stag antlers rise from his helm. His face is a pale stern old man's face with a long white beard and eyes that shine cold white. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: tarnished silver plate armour rimed with white frost, a long charcoal-black wolf-fur cloak, ivory stag antlers, a white beard, a pale ice-white glowing sword blade, a big curved ivory ox horn with brass bands.
wears: He wears an ornate tarnished silver helm with an open face, crowned with two great ivory stag antlers, an engraved silver breastplate and shoulder plates rimed with frost, tall dark leather hunting boots, and a long tattered charcoal-black wolf-fur cloak streaming behind him.
holds: He holds exactly one long straight sword in his right hand, its thick blade glowing pale ice-white. In his left hand he holds exactly one great blowing horn made from the horn of an ox: a thick crescent-shaped ivory horn, curved like a bull's horn or a new moon, narrow at the mouth end and wide at the open end, with three brass bands round it. He holds its narrow end to his lips and its wide end curves upward.
pose: He strides to the left on two legs with one foot forward, head tilted back blowing the big curved horn held to his mouth with his left hand, the glowing sword swept out low and wide in his right hand, cloak streaming back.
must_show: great stag antlers on the helm
a crescent-curved ox-horn (not a straight trumpet) held to the mouth
one pale glowing sword
ornate silver armour and dark fur cloak
ghostly huntsman-king, ornate and imposing

what: a cave bear: a real Ice Age bear, an enormous shaggy brown bear on four legs, a real animal. It has a huge head with a high domed forehead, small round ears, a long muzzle with big yellowed fangs, a great hump of muscle over the shoulders, thick legs and long curved claws.
colours: shaggy dark chestnut-brown fur with a lighter tawny muzzle, a black nose, yellowed fangs, ivory claws.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it charges to the left on four legs, hind legs driving, one front paw lifted high and swiping with its claws spread, head low, jaws wide open roaring.
must_show: a real bear on four legs, seen from the side
enormous, shaggy, humped shoulders
jaws open with fangs
one front paw swiping with long claws

what: a cave toad: a real toad grown to the size of a big dog, a fat squat four-legged animal with a wide flat head, a huge mouth, bulging golden eyes, a lumpy back full of warts, and one big swollen pale gland bulging behind each eye. Its long thick tongue shoots straight out of its open mouth.
colours: mottled dark brown and dull ochre warty skin, a pale cream belly and throat, pale cream glands behind the eyes, golden eyes, a thick pink tongue.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it squats facing left with its hind legs folded and its front legs braced, body tipped forward, mouth gaping wide and its long thick pink tongue lashing straight out to the left, still joined to the mouth.
must_show: a giant toad on four legs, squat and warty
swollen pale glands behind the eyes
wide open mouth
long thick tongue lashing out, attached to the mouth

what: a chaos spawn: a creature with no proper shape, one low sagging heap of living flesh like a great lump of melting wax, wider than it is tall. It has no head, no neck, no shoulders, no chest and no belly: it is all one lump. A wide crooked mouth full of uneven fangs splits the lump across its middle, and seven yellow eyes of different sizes are scattered unevenly all over the lump, some high, some low. One single huge crab-like arm ending in three long bone claws sticks out of its left side; one small ragged bat wing sticks out of the top right; two thick tentacles curl up out of its top. It drags itself on three short stumpy feet of different sizes at the bottom of the lump.
colours: mottled dark violet and black lumpy hide with dull magenta veins, sickly yellow eyes, pale bone-white claws and fangs.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing; its one claw is empty.
pose: It lurches to the left, the whole lump tipped and sagging to one side, the single huge claw arm flung out to the left and reaching, the small wing flapping, the two tentacles lashing above it.
must_show: a shapeless lump, not a humanoid: no head on a neck, no man's torso
exactly one big claw arm on one side and one small bat wing on the other
many mismatched yellow eyes scattered over the lump
a crooked fanged mouth in the body
violet-black hide

what: a Charybdis spawn: a small round sea creature shaped like a thick fleshy disc, seen face-on, like a giant sea anemone crossed with a lamprey. In the exact centre of the disc is a wide round open mouth, a pitch-black hole with no pupil and no iris, ringed all the way round with one row of big white triangular shark teeth that point inward. The flesh of the disc is ridged in a spiral that winds inward to the mouth like a whirlpool. Exactly eight short thick tentacles stick out evenly from the rim of the disc, all bent the same way round like the arms of a pinwheel. It has no eyes.
colours: deep teal and sea-blue ridged flesh, a pitch-black mouth hole, big white teeth, pale aqua tentacle tips.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the front, it floats with its maw gaping towards the viewer, its eight short tentacles flung out and curling round in one spinning direction.
must_show: a round disc body with a round toothed maw in the centre that reads as a mouth, not an eye
white teeth round the maw, visible in the small sprite
spiral ridges winding into the maw like a whirlpool
short tentacles round the rim, bent like a pinwheel
small and plain next to Charybdis

what: Charybdis, the whirlpool monster of Greek myth: a vast round sea monster that is almost all mouth, seen face-on. Her body is a huge thick fleshy ring around a gaping round maw, and the maw is lined with three rings of long curved ivory fangs, one ring inside another, going down into a black throat. The flesh of the ring is ridged in a deep spiral that winds inward like a whirlpool. A crown of tall bone-white spines stands along the top of the ring, six small glowing yellow eyes are set round the maw, and eight long thick tentacles crusted with pale barnacles sweep out from the rim, all curling the same way round. She has no legs, no feet and no claws: below the ring there are only tentacles.
colours: deep sea-blue and dark teal ridged flesh, a black throat, ivory fangs, bone-white spines, pale gold barnacles, glowing yellow eyes.
wears: She is a sea monster and wears nothing; her crown is a natural row of spines.
holds: She holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the front, she surges towards the viewer with her great maw gaping, her eight long tentacles sweeping round her in one spinning direction like the arms of a whirlpool.
must_show: a huge round maw with several rings of long fangs
spiral ridges winding into the maw like a whirlpool
crown of bone-white spines
long barnacled tentacles sweeping round
glowing yellow eyes round the maw
far larger and more ornate than the spawn

what: a chimera of Greek myth, drawn as on an ancient Greek vase: a big maned lion on four legs with two extra heads growing out of its own body. First, out of the lion's spine halfway along its back, sticks up one single goat neck with one horned goat head on it, like a second head growing from the lion: there is no goat body and no goat legs, and there is only this one goat head. Second, the lion has no lion's tail: where its tail should be, a thick scaly snake grows out of its rump, curves up in the air behind the lion like a raised tail, and ends in a snake's head with open jaws. The snake is the tail and touches nothing else.
colours: tawny gold lion fur, a dark brown mane, one grey-white goat head with two curved black horns, a dark green scaly snake for a tail, a short tongue of orange and yellow flame.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, the lion stands on four legs facing left with one front paw lifted to strike, roaring with a short tongue of flame coming straight out of its mouth. The single goat head on its back looks forward over the mane. The snake tail curves up behind the rump in a hook, its snake head hissing.
must_show: a lion's body and maned lion head, on four legs
exactly one goat's head with horns rising from the middle of the back
a serpent for a tail, rearing up and ending in a snake's head
a little fire from the lion's mouth, attached to the mouth
must_not_show: a whole goat standing or lying on its back
snake coiled on the lion's back
lion's tufted tail as well as the snake

what: an undead colossus: a towering dead giant crudely sewn together from the limbs of several giants, with thick ship's rope for stitches. Its arms do not match: the right arm is far longer and thicker than the left. It has a small drooping bald head with blank white eyes and a hanging jaw, wide lopsided shoulders, a deep chest and thick legs. Angular runes are burned into the hide of its chest and arms and glow dully like embers. Every part of it, the head included, is dead ash-grey flesh.
colours: ash-grey and bone-pale dead skin in big mismatched pieces, thick tan ship's rope stitches at every joint, dull orange glowing runes, a torn dirty-white sailcloth wrap.
wears: It wears only a torn dirty-white sailcloth wrap around its hips.
holds: Its hands are empty; it holds nothing.
pose: It strides forward on two legs, leaning into the blow, its huge long right fist swinging down and forward in a hammer punch, its shorter left arm thrown back behind it, head lolling to one side.
must_show: a giant dead body in mismatched pieces, ash-grey
thick tan rope stitches at the joints
glowing orange runes burned into the hide
mismatched arms, one much bigger
blank dead face, empty fists

what: a flesh colossus: a vast hulking dead giant made of the corpses of many soldiers sewn into one body, far wider and heavier than any other stitched giant, hunched and neckless, with arms thicker than its legs. Every part of it is dead flesh, cold and grey, never living pink. Its hide is a patchwork quilt of skin: about a dozen very large irregular patches, each as big as its own head or bigger, in three plainly different tones set side by side, pale ash-grey next to dark slate-grey next to dull sallow tan, on its chest, belly, shoulders, arms and legs alike. Every patch is outlined all the way round by a broad black seam as thick as a rope, crossed by big dull iron staples, so that the whole body is covered in a bold black net of seams. Its trunk is one great lumpy uneven mass, bulging in the wrong places, with no chest muscles and no belly muscles drawn on it, only patches and seams. Three faces are sunk flat into the front of its body like masks pressed into wet clay, part of the skin and no higher than the skin around them: one on each side of its chest, each as wide as its own head, and one in its belly below them. Each is a bone-white mask of grief, hairless, with two black eye holes and one black open mouth hole, and no neck and no ears. Its own head is small, bald and grey, sunk low between its great rounded shoulders, with blank white eyes and a slack jaw; it is the only head. Exactly four thick copper rods stand up from the top of its back behind the head, each tipped with one small blue-white spark.
colours: cold dead skin in very large patches of three tones, pale ash-grey, dark slate-grey and dull sallow tan, each patch outlined by a broad black seam with dull iron staples, three bone-white mask faces with black eye and mouth holes sunk in the chest and belly, four bright copper rods, small blue-white sparks, a dark brown leather kilt.
wears: It wears only a long ragged dark brown leather kilt that hangs from its waist to its knees, made of soldiers' belts. It has no armour, no helmet and no metal plates anywhere.
holds: Its hands are empty; it holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the front: it stomps forward on two legs with one foot raised, hunched under its own shoulders, both enormous bare hands open and reaching forward and outward to grab, so that its whole patchwork chest and belly with the three mask faces sunk in them are turned to the viewer.
must_show: a vast hunched patchwork giant: about a dozen very large skin patches in three tones, pale grey, dark grey and sallow tan
a bold black net of seams round every patch, plain to see at 64 px
three flat bone-white mask faces sunk in the flesh of its chest and belly: faces in the skin, not extra heads
one small head only, low between the shoulders
copper rods on the back with small blue-white sparks
open empty hands
must_not_show: faces standing up from the shoulders
one even grey colour all over

what: a corrupted pegasus: a real horse with two large feathered bird wings growing from its shoulders, its whole coat darkened to the colour of soot. It is a lean, wild-eyed stallion with a ragged mane and tail, cold white eyes with no pupils, and pale frost clinging to its four hooves. It has no horn.
colours: soot-black coat, charcoal-grey wing feathers with black tips, a ragged dull grey mane and tail, cold white eyes, pale white frost on the hooves.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing: no saddle, no bridle.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it rears up on its two hind legs facing left, both front hooves striking out ahead of it, both wings spread wide and raised above its back, mane flying, mouth open.
must_show: a horse with two feathered wings
soot-black coat, dark wings
cold white eyes
rearing, front hooves striking
no horn

what: a corrupted unicorn: a real horse with one horn growing from the middle of its forehead, and no wings. The horn is jet black, as thick as the horse's own foreleg at its base, gnarled and knotted, and it is curved: one long single horn in the shape of a crescent moon, sweeping forward and upward from the forehead in one bold arc to a sharp point, as long as the horse's whole head. Its once-white coat has gone the dull grey of cold ash. From the base of the horn a web of thick black branching lines, each as thick as a finger, spreads over its whole face, down its neck and across its shoulder and chest, bold and plainly seen against the grey coat. It has a tangled black mane and tail, a short tuft of beard under the chin, cloven hooves, and angry glowing violet eyes.
colours: dull ash-grey coat, the grey of cold ash, with a web of thick black branching lines on the face, neck, shoulder and chest, a jet-black curved horn, a tangled black mane and tail, glowing violet eyes, black hooves.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing: no saddle, no bridle.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it gallops to the left on four legs at a full charge, front legs reaching and hind legs kicked out behind, its neck stretched out low and its head lowered to the level of its own chest, so the great curved black horn hooks forward and up against the empty backdrop at the left of the picture, mane streaming back.
must_show: a horse with one horn on the forehead
the horn black, thick and plainly curved like a crescent moon, not straight
ash-grey coat with a bold web of black lines on the face, neck and shoulder; black mane
violet eyes
charging with the horn lowered, on four legs
no wings

what: a corrupted treant: a walking tree in the rough shape of a giant, an ancient oak whose trunk is its body. It has a gnarled face in the bark of the trunk with a jagged hollow mouth and two deep eye-hollows that glow sickly yellow, two long heavy branch arms ending in knotted wooden fingers, a crown of bare dead branches for hair, and two thick legs of twisted roots with long root toes. All of its bark, from crown to roots, has gone black, hard and cracked, and thick sickly yellow sap oozes from the cracks. Only a few dead brown leaves still hang from its crown.
colours: black and dark charcoal cracked bark on every part, sickly yellow glowing eyes and sap, a few dead rust-brown leaves, pale grey fungus shelves on one shoulder.
wears: It is a tree and wears nothing.
holds: Its branch hands are empty; it holds nothing.
pose: It strides forward on its two root legs with one root foot lifted and its groping root toes spread, its right branch arm swung high overhead to slam down, its left branch arm reaching forward with wooden fingers spread, hollow mouth open.
must_show: a walking tree with a face in the trunk
black cracked bark on every part
sickly yellow glowing eyes and sap
bare dead branches, almost no leaves
branch arms and root legs, empty hands

what: a corrupted angel: a tall fallen angel warrior standing on two legs, with a stern, hollow-cheeked, pale human face, long lank ash-white hair and eyes that glare harsh yellow-white. Two large feathered wings rise from its back, their feathers gone ash-grey with ragged blackened tips and gaps where feathers have fallen out. It has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: pale grey skin, ash-white hair, ash-grey wing feathers with black tips, tarnished dull silver armour, a tattered dirty grey-white robe, a harsh pale yellow-white glare, a steel sword.
wears: It wears a tarnished, dented silver breastplate and bracers over a long tattered dirty grey-white soldier's robe with a ragged hem. Its head is bare: no helmet, no crown and no halo.
holds: It holds exactly one long straight steel sword in its right hand, raised high. Its left hand is empty and thrust out with the palm open, and a bright ball of harsh pale yellow-white light, the size of an apple, burns in that open palm, touching the hand.
pose: It lunges to the left on two legs, front knee deeply bent and back leg stretched out behind, body twisted, its right arm lifted high above its head with the sword raised for a downward cut, its left arm stretched straight out ahead with the ball of pale light blazing in the open palm, wings half spread and swept back.
must_show: angel: human figure with two feathered wings
the wings ash-grey and ragged with black tips
tarnished silver armour over a tattered pale robe
one sword, raised
a ball of pale yellow-white light in the open left palm
bare head, no crown, no tail

what: Abaddon the Destroyer, the angel of the bottomless pit and king of the locusts from the Book of Revelation: a towering, broad, terrible fallen angel-king standing on two legs. He has a gaunt ash-grey face like a stern man's with a lion's long fangs, eyes that burn orange, and long black hair. Two vast black feathered wings spread from his back. From the base of his spine grows the tail of a giant scorpion: a thick chain of six fat round black segments like huge beads, which rises straight up behind his back and arches forward high above his crown, between the wings, ending in a swollen bulb with one big curved golden sting that points forward and down over his head. His hands are bare grey claws with long black talons. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: black plate armour with rich gold trim and engraving, a tall gold crown, ash-grey skin, black feathered wings, a black scorpion tail with a gold stinger, burning orange eyes, orange and yellow hellfire, a tattered black cape with a gold border.
wears: He wears a tall spiked gold crown, a full suit of ornate black plate armour edged and engraved with gold, with great spiked shoulder plates shaped like locust heads, a gold breastplate medallion, and a long tattered black cape with a gold border. His head is crowned, not helmeted, so his face shows.
holds: His clawed hands are empty and he holds no weapon. A ball of orange and yellow hellfire burns in his raised right palm, touching the hand; his left hand is an open claw with long talons, reaching forward.
pose: He strides forward on two legs with one foot ahead, body twisted, right hand raised out to the side with the hellfire burning in its palm, left claw reaching out low, both great wings spread wide, the scorpion tail arched up over the top of his crowned head with its golden sting hanging forward above him, mouth open showing fangs.
must_show: tall spiked gold crown
vast black feathered wings
a scorpion tail of fat segments arching over his head, ending in one curved sting
ornate black and gold plate armour
hellfire in the right palm, empty clawed hands
the most ornate and imposing figure of all: the final boss
must_not_show: tail with a head on it
tail lying low by the feet

what: a carrion crawler: a giant fat caterpillar as long as a horse, with a soft segmented body of a dozen bulging rings, a row of many short stubby legs along its underside, a small round head with two black bead eyes, and a ring of eight long thick wet tentacles sprouting all round its mouth like the arms of a sea anemone.
colours: pale sickly green body with a paler yellow-cream underside, darker green bands between the segments, pale pink tentacles with darker tips, black eyes.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it faces left with the back half of its long body flat and level and the front third reared up off the ground in a curve, all eight mouth tentacles spread wide and reaching forward to the left.
must_show: a giant pale green caterpillar with a segmented body
many short stubby legs along the underside
a ring of eight thick tentacles round the mouth
soft body, no hard plates

what: a frost crawler: a giant centipede as long as a wagon, with a long flat body of many hard overlapping plates, every plate rimed with white frost and edged with small icicles. Each segment has one pair of long, sharp, pointed jointed legs sticking out sideways. Its flat head has two long thick antennae and a pair of big curved pincer jaws of clear ice. Every part of it, the head and legs included, is frosted and icy.
colours: dark steel-blue plates rimed with white frost, pale ice-blue legs and antennae, clear cyan ice jaws, small white icicles, pale blue eyes.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it faces left with its long body in an S-shaped wave, the tail end level and the front third reared up high off the ground, its many pointed legs spread, pincer jaws wide open to bite.
must_show: a giant centipede: long body of hard plates, many pointed legs
frost and icicles on the plates
big icy pincer jaws
steel-blue and white colouring
harder, sharper and more dangerous than the soft carrion crawler
must_not_show: cloud of mist around the body
patch of snow or ice under it

what: a crypt thing: a skeleton tomb-guardian, a bare ivory skull with small pale cyan lights in its eye sockets inside a deep plain hood, with bare bone hands and bare bone feet. It carries the key of the crypt it guards: one huge old-fashioned black iron key as long as its whole arm, held up like a mace. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: ivory bone, a plain dusty earth-brown hooded burial robe, one huge black iron key, a small pale cyan light.
wears: It wears a plain dusty earth-brown hooded burial robe that hangs to its ankles, tied with a rope belt, frayed at the hem, with no trim or decoration at all. Nothing hangs round its neck.
holds: In its right bone hand, raised high beside its hood, it grips exactly one huge black iron key as long as its arm, held upright and clear of its body against the plain backdrop: at the bottom, in its fist, a big round iron ring as wide as its skull; from the ring a thick straight iron shank as thick as its wrist rising straight up; and at the top end of the shank two big square iron teeth sticking out to the left like a small flag. Its left hand is empty and thrust out ahead: a small tight spiral of pale cyan light, no bigger than its fist, turns just above the palm, touching the fingers. It has no staff and no other weapon.
pose: It lunges forward to the left on two legs out of a stoop, its left hand thrust out ahead with the cyan spiral in its palm, its right hand raised high behind its hood brandishing the huge black iron key upright like a mace, robe swinging.
must_show: skeleton (bare skull, bone hands)
plain brown hooded robe, no finery
one huge black iron key brandished in the right hand: a ring at the bottom, a thick shank, two square teeth at the top, readable as a key at 64 px
a small pale cyan light at an empty palm (not a big ball)
realistic adult proportions (small skull, long limbs)
must_not_show: ring on a chain at the chest

what: a crypt summoner: the corpse of a long-dead necromancer scholar, a tall gaunt withered dead man. His skin is cold chalk-grey, the grey of cold ash, on his face, neck, hands and feet alike, dry and shrunk tight on the skull, with the lips dried back from the teeth, a thin sharp nose, withered ears, sunken eyes that glow, a thin wispy white beard and long thin withered fingers. He has the look of a stern old bookkeeper. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: cold chalk-grey dead skin, long black scholar's robes with dull gold trim, a close-fitting round black cloth skullcap, a thick brown leather ledger with grey-white pages, small ivory bones, one ball of bright emerald-green flame, a wispy white beard.
wears: He wears long black scholar's robes that reach his ankles, with dull gold embroidered trim at the collar, cuffs and hem, a close-fitting round black cloth skullcap that sits tight on the crown of his head like a medieval clerk's, and a belt hung with a row of small ivory finger bones and an inkpot.
holds: He holds exactly one big thick open ledger book in his left hand, propped against his forearm. His right hand is empty and raised with the palm open, and one round ball of bright emerald-green flame as big as his fist burns in that palm, touching the hand, deep green with a bright green core. He has no staff and no weapon.
pose: He leans forward on two legs with one foot ahead, the open ledger held up before his chest in his left hand, his right arm stretched out and up toward his target with the ball of emerald-green flame burning in the open palm, robe sleeves swept back.
must_show: withered chalk-grey dead face with flesh on it and a wispy beard (not a bare skull, not green)
black scholar's robes with gold trim and a round black skullcap
one big open ledger book in the left hand
green magic at the empty right hand
richer and more learned-looking than the plain crypt thing
realistic adult proportions (small head, long limbs)
